pages.text: $(italic)A mythical beast of impossible speed. The fastest race in the game.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Wall Climber$() — $(item)Scale walls like a spider$(). Toggle with save toolbar key.$(br2)$(bold)Cat Vision$() — $(item)Natural night vision$(). See clearly in darkness.$(br2)$(bold)Fall Immunity$() — $(item)Always land safely.$(br2)$(bold)Pounce$() — $(item)Launch forward with a burst of speed$(). 25-second cooldown.$(br2)$(bold)Unrivaled Speed$() — $(item)Speed II burst for 12 seconds$(). 60-second cooldown.

pages.title: Speed's Cost
pages.text: $(bold)Nine Lives$() — $(warn)-20% max HP (4 fewer hearts)$(). Your lithe frame is fragile.$(br2)$(bold)Restless Metabolism$() — $(warn)Constant movement burns through food quickly$(). High exhaustion rate.$(br2)$(bold)Sprint Jump$() — Enhanced jumping while sprinting. Combined with Wall Climber and Pounce, the Kirin is the most mobile race in the game.$(br2)$(italic)Pairs best with mobile classes like Samurai, Ranger, or Wanderer. Avoid Vanguard — you want to move, not stand still.$()
